subject.title: [P0] Feishu connector: sequential queue deadlock + self-talk feedback loop under slow LLM

question: Should the remaining slow-run repair be owned by Feishu queue admission, shared gateway/session abort and backpressure semantics, or a split between those layers?
rationale: The remaining failure crosses channel ordering, shared active-run queue policy, task cancellation, and session write-lock recovery, and each fix location has different compatibility implications for Feishu and other channels.

options.title: Split channel and core ownership
options.body: Let Feishu stop holding ordinary followups behind the full handler while shared core owns abort/fencing and session-lock recovery semantics.

options.title: Feishu-only containment
options.body: Add Feishu-local timeout, queue-depth, and self-send protections while leaving shared gateway/session behavior unchanged.

options.title: Core-first redesign
options.body: Hold Feishu changes until a shared gateway/session concurrency model covers all channels consistently.

recommendation.title: Split channel and core ownership
recommendation.body: Let Feishu stop holding ordinary followups behind the full handler while shared core owns abort/fencing and session-lock recovery semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history and issue discussion tie this person to the current Feishu queue timeout and active-followup boundary analysis.
